corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez text clearly has 'ወመጠዎሙ' ('and he gave/handed over to them', from መጠወ), where Stage 1 skipped the second Fidel 'መ'.
Across the line wrap to L06 ('ለው ፡ ሥዕል'), the word is 'ለተሣለው ፡ ሥዕል' ('to the painted image/icon'). Visually the glyph at the end of L05 has the top crown of 'ሣ' (not 'ማ').
